high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post by Bhavuna Gupta, who identifies herself as a "Growth Marketing Practitioner | Enthusiastic Traveler." The post was made on August 18 and asks, "What is one picture on social media which made you happy today?" Below the question, there are three images with text overlaid. Top Image: This image features a man holding two newspapers. One newspaper has the headline "Kabul" and the other appears to have an article about a central bank. The text overlay reads, "THE ONE WHO SHOWCASES FUTURE WORLD SC
